payload.prompt: Direct implementation of requested artifact: Create a file named POW_001_LAUNCH_SPEC.md containing the canonical launch specification for the POW-001 Bitcoin-native fixed-supply sponsorship concept. The specification must define: PRODUCT NAME: POW-001 Genesis Sponsorship. CONCEPT: Exactly 21 equal company blocks on the next work machine. RULES: (1) Exactly 21 blocks total, no more, no less. (2) One block maximum per company. (3) Price: 499 EUR per block, paid in Bitcoin. (4) No auction - first come first served. (5) No VIP tier. (6) No replacement blocks once sold. (7) Physical placement on the machine corresponds to the digital Genesis position. (8) Permanent digital Genesis archive records all 21 positions. (9) Work Log begins after Genesis is complete. (10) The internal Genesis Chain is NOT the Bitcoin blockchain - do not misrepresent. HUMAN GATES: Financial actions, wallet signing, spending, machine purchase, paid advertising, contracts and external publication require explicit human approval. FORMAT: Professional markdown specification document suitable for sharing with potential sponsors. Include sections for Overview, Rules, Pricing, Genesis Archive, Work Log, Human Gates, and Status.
